moments.author: Sal Frelick
moments.quote: Hit a clutch game‑tying homer to dead center on ninth pitch in Game 2 of the World Series
moments.why: An unlikely hero delivers a comeback swing that has Brewers fans and sports circles buzzing across platforms.

moments.author: Thibaut Courtois
moments.quote: Ruled out of El Clásico due to flu; late drama over possible recovery, but ultimately stayed in Madrid
